title: Machine-written Items record the run that wrote them
description: All 1,388 Machines on Machines Items had empty createdBy and source, so cleanup had to select on type, stage and status. Every machine write records its run id. Undoing a run is one reversible step. Ties into who-wrote-what on the Chatticus channel record. Holds knowledge-run rollouts with the preview story. Gherkin specs.
